// diagnostic

E0402

Fallible call ignored as a statement

What

Fallible call ignored as a statement

Why

A failure no code looks at is lost silently, so a fallible call's result must be handled

Fix

Handle, propagate, or explicitly discard the fallible result.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0402: Tests/UI/SecretsExpiry/expiring_secret_loan_rejects_move_variadic_and_drop_paths.stderr.

Error [jet.MissingMoveMarker]: ExpiringSecret loan `borrowed` cannot be moved
  --> Tests/UI/SecretsExpiry/expiring_secret_loan_rejects_move_variadic_and_drop_paths.jet:15:17
    |
 15 |         consume(borrowed)
    |                 ^^^^^^^^
 Why: The callback receives temporary read access; moving, changing, or dropping it could let the credential escape its expiry boundary
 Fix: Use the loan only for read-only operations inside this callback
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0201

Error [jet.FallibleCallIgnored]: This call can fail and nothing checks it
  --> Tests/UI/SecretsExpiry/expiring_secret_loan_rejects_move_variadic_and_drop_paths.jet:15:9
    |
 15 |         consume(borrowed)
    |         ^^^^^^^
 Why: A fallible result can't be ignored — handle it or say failure is impossible
 Fix: Use `?`, `??`, `panic ...`, or `.drop("reason")` to intentionally discard
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0402

Error [jet.ReturnTypeMismatch]: This value is Int (a whole number), but this lambda returns Err!
  --> Tests/UI/SecretsExpiry/expiring_secret_loan_rejects_move_variadic_and_drop_paths.jet:16:16
    |
 16 |         return 0
    |                ^
 Why: This lambda's result is Err!, so the value it hands back must be Err!
 Fix: Hand back a Err! value: convert this value to Err!, or return the value you meant
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0113

Error [jet.MissingErrorConversion]: This implicit fallible call can't convert `Expired` into `Err` — no declared conversion exists
  --> Tests/UI/SecretsExpiry/expiring_secret_loan_rejects_move_variadic_and_drop_paths.jet:14:17
    |
 14 |     _ := secret.with(fn(borrowed) {
    |                 ^^^^
 Why: Ordinary fallible calls propagate automatically; `Expired` can reach `Err` only through `impl Err.From(Expired)`
 Fix: Handle this call locally with `??`, add `impl Err.From(Expired) { … }`, or change the return type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2402
